name: steward
description: Separate intent and assurance from software construction with traced, approved Markdown contracts. Frame maps intent through claims and evidence, critique independently challenges the proposal, and assess binds claim outcomes to an immutable change with remediation routing.

interface.longDescription: Create traceable Markdown contracts with representative intent probes and explicit unknowns, independently critique them, freeze an explicitly approved revision, and assess immutable software changes claim by claim with reproducible evidence and remediation routing. Steward keeps intent and assurance separate from the interchangeable builder and requires no remote service or builder adapter.
defaultPrompt: Frame this request as an approvable contract.
Assess this change against its frozen contract.
